quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the matching clothes some students wear to school!
quests.question: Uniform
quests.hint: Many students at the same school wear this exact same outfit.
quests.explanation: Yes! A uniform is the matching outfit that shows students belong to their school.
quests.funFact: School uniforms come in many colors, and each school often chooses its own!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the time the whole school gathers together for an announcement!
quests.question: School Assembly
quests.hint: During this event, every class in the school gathers in one place.
quests.explanation: Yes! A school assembly is when the whole school gathers together for news or a show.
quests.funFact: A school assembly can include songs, awards, or special guests visiting the school!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the chart that shows what class comes next!
quests.question: Timetable
quests.hint: This chart lists each subject and the time it happens during the day.
quests.explanation: Yes! A timetable is the chart that shows what class happens next.
quests.funFact: A timetable helps students and teachers know exactly what to do all day long!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the special gathering when every class meets in one big room!
quests.question: School Assembly
quests.hint: You might hear announcements, songs, or a special performance during this time.
quests.explanation: That's right! Every class comes together during a school assembly.
quests.funFact: A school assembly can include songs, awards, or special guests visiting the school!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the special outfit that shows you belong to your school!
quests.question: Uniform
quests.hint: It often includes a matching shirt, and sometimes a tie or a badge.
quests.explanation: That's right! Wearing a uniform shows that students belong to the same school.
quests.funFact: School uniforms come in many colors, and each school often chooses its own!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the schedule that tells us when math or art class begins!
quests.question: Timetable
quests.hint: You check it to see what class is coming up next.
quests.explanation: That's right! We check a timetable to know when math or art class begins.
quests.funFact: A timetable helps students and teachers know exactly what to do all day long!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the chart that plans out each part of the school day!
quests.question: Timetable
quests.hint: This chart lists each subject and the time it happens during the day.
quests.explanation: Well done! A timetable helps the whole class know what to expect each day.
quests.funFact: A timetable helps students and teachers know exactly what to do all day long!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the matching shirt and pants some schools ask students to wear!
quests.question: Uniform
quests.hint: Many students at the same school wear this exact same outfit.
quests.explanation: Well done! A uniform helps every student look neat and ready to learn.
quests.funFact: School uniforms come in many colors, and each school often chooses its own!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the event when the whole school listens together to news or a show!
quests.question: School Assembly
quests.hint: During this event, every class in the school gathers in one place.
quests.explanation: Well done! A school assembly brings the whole school together to share something special.
quests.funFact: A school assembly can include songs, awards, or special guests visiting the school!

quests.instruction: Point to the tool teachers often use to write big words on a board!
quests.question: Marker
quests.hint: If you leave its cap off too long, it can dry out.
quests.explanation: Well done! A marker's ink is thicker and darker than a pencil's.
quests.funFact: Some markers even smell like fruit, such as strawberry or grape!

quests.instruction: Find the tool we press down to snap two papers firmly together!
quests.question: Stapler
quests.hint: It makes a little click sound when you press it down.
quests.explanation: Yes! A stapler presses a tiny metal pin through papers to hold them together.
quests.funFact: A stapler can join many sheets of paper together in just one press!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the class where we learn how to spell new words!
quests.question: Spelling
quests.hint: You practice new words each week during this subject.
quests.explanation: Well done! Spelling helps us write words the correct way every time.
quests.funFact: Practicing a new word a few times can help you remember how to spell it!

quests.instruction: Find the tool that snips paper into new shapes when you squeeze it!
quests.question: Scissors
quests.hint: You put your fingers in its handles and squeeze to make it cut.
quests.explanation: That's right! We squeeze the handles of scissors to cut along a line.
quests.funFact: School scissors often have rounded tips to help keep little fingers safe!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the careful driver who gets students home safely!
quests.question: Bus Driver
quests.hint: This person sits at the front of the bus, holding the big wheel.
quests.explanation: Yes! A bus driver steers the school bus safely to and from school.
quests.funFact: A bus driver often learns the names of every student who rides their bus!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the daily plan that tells every class exactly when to start!
quests.question: Timetable
quests.hint: You check it to see what class is coming up next.
quests.explanation: Yes! A timetable is the chart that shows what class happens next.
quests.funFact: A timetable helps students and teachers know exactly what to do all day long!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the subject where we explore plants, animals, and how things work!
quests.question: Science
quests.hint: This subject is full of experiments and questions about the world.
quests.explanation: That's right! We ask questions and try experiments during science class.
quests.funFact: Scientists ask questions and test ideas, just like students do in science class!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the matching clothes that make every student look ready for the day!
quests.question: Uniform
quests.hint: It often includes a matching shirt, and sometimes a tie or a badge.
quests.explanation: Yes! A uniform is the matching outfit that shows students belong to their school.
quests.funFact: School uniforms come in many colors, and each school often chooses its own!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the class where numbers help us solve puzzles!
quests.question: Math
quests.hint: This subject is full of numbers, counting, and number puzzles.
quests.explanation: Yes! Math is the subject where we count, add, and solve number problems.
quests.funFact: Math is used everywhere, from counting your toys to telling the time!

quests.instruction: Find the flat chart that helps us find our way to a new place!
quests.question: Map
quests.hint: You look at it to figure out where a place is located.
quests.explanation: Well done! A map helps us understand where different places are in the world.
quests.funFact: A map can show a whole country, or it can show just your own street!

quests.instruction: Find the word for the person who trains a team and cheers them on!
quests.question: Coach
quests.hint: This helper often encourages the whole team during practice or a game.
quests.explanation: Well done! A coach helps students learn new skills and enjoy playing together.
quests.funFact: A good coach cheers on every player, whether the team wins or loses!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the room where you sit and learn each day!
quests.question: Classroom
quests.hint: Your teacher and your classmates spend most of the day here with you.
quests.explanation: That's right! A classroom has desks, chairs, and a board for lessons.
quests.funFact: Classrooms around the world can look very different, but they are all places to learn!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the quiet room filled with rows of books!
quests.question: Library
quests.hint: This room is filled with shelf after shelf of books to borrow.
quests.explanation: Well done! A library keeps rows and rows of books for everyone to enjoy.
quests.funFact: A library can hold thousands of books for students to borrow and enjoy!

quests.instruction: Point to the item that keeps your homework neat inside your backpack!
quests.question: Folder
quests.hint: It keeps your worksheets flat and safe inside your backpack.
quests.explanation: Well done! A folder protects our papers on the way to and from school.
quests.funFact: Colorful folders can help students quickly find the right subject for each class!

quests.instruction: Touch the small tool that gives a pencil a fresh, pointy tip again!
quests.question: Sharpener
quests.hint: You twist your pencil inside this small tool to fix its tip.
quests.explanation: That's right! We twist a pencil inside a sharpener to make it pointy.
quests.funFact: The curly bits of wood a sharpener makes are called pencil shavings!

quests.instruction: Touch the word for the subject that helps us put our ideas onto paper!
quests.question: Writing
quests.hint: This subject is all about letters, sentences, and your very own stories.
quests.explanation: Yes! Writing is the subject where we practice letters, sentences, and stories.
quests.funFact: Learning to write neatly takes practice, just like learning to read does!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the tall furniture that holds rows of books!
quests.question: Bookshelf
quests.hint: It has several flat levels, each one holding a row of books.
quests.explanation: That's right! We return our books to the bookshelf when we're finished reading.
quests.funFact: A tall bookshelf can hold hundreds of books on just a few shelves!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for a person who comes to school to learn!
quests.question: Student
quests.hint: This person carries a backpack and sits at a desk to learn.
quests.explanation: Yes! A student is a person who goes to school to learn new things.
quests.funFact: Students all around the world go to school to learn new things every day!

quests.instruction: Touch the school word for the happy time when we go outside to play!
quests.question: Recess
quests.hint: This is a short, happy break from lessons spent outside.
quests.explanation: Well done! Recess gives every student a fun break from classroom lessons.
quests.funFact: Recess helps students feel refreshed and ready to learn again afterward!

quests.instruction: Point to the word for the subject where every new page holds a new adventure!
quests.question: Reading
quests.hint: You practice sounding out words and understanding stories during this time.
quests.explanation: That's right! We sound out words and enjoy stories during reading class.
quests.funFact: The more you practice reading, the faster you can recognize new words!

quests.instruction: Touch the bag you carry on your back every single school day!
quests.question: Backpack
quests.hint: You pack it in the morning and open it again after school.
quests.explanation: Well done! A backpack has room for books, pencils, and even a snack.
quests.funFact: Backpacks have two straps so the weight spreads evenly across both shoulders!
